GRASS FED AND FINISHED BEEF

Your beef will be hand selected from our herd when we are certain it is beautifully fat and ready, a good half year older than most. Calmly raised on our rich pastures and clean waters with living soil under hoof and open sky above, our cattle and grasslands belong together. They are harvested in the summer and fall after they have given to and grown from the season’s bounty.

Reserve your beef share with a deposit. We will invoice you for the balance once your animal is harvested. The exact weight of your individual share will determine your total cost. Whole & Half Shares are custom cut to your specifications, and are guaranteed bones, heart, liver, oxtail and tongue as desired. Quarter & Eighth Shares are our curated mix of ground beef, steaks, roasts, and more. Here is what you’ll get in a typical Quarter Beef Share.

Whole Beef Share $6.00/lb plus butcher cut and wrap fees. Average total price for a Whole Beef is $5600. (approx 460 lbs take home meat).

Half Beef Share $6.40/lb plus butcher cut and wrap fees. Average total price for a Half Beef is $3100. (approx 240 lbs take home meat).

Quarter Beef Share $7.20/lb plus butcher cut and wrap fees. Average total price for a Quarter Beef is $1800. (approx 130 lbs of take home meat).

Eighth Beef Share $7.60/lb plus butcher cut and wrap fees. Average total price for an Eighth Beef is $980. (approx 66 lbs of take home meat).

1/8th ALL GROUND BEEF Share $6.20/lb plus butcher cut and wrap fees. Average total price is $640 for approx 52 lbs of high quality “80/20” grassfinished ground beef from our same market animals.

If you would prefer a Ground Beef Share from a smaller animal - for less take home lbs - please let Aimee know!

In much the same way the fruit tree offers her gifts of peaches, cherries, or apples but once a year, so do the grasslands deliver with the seasons. Our pasture-raised animals are harvested and delivered primarily in the summer and autumn, with one winter delivery per location to top off your freezers before the next coming season. 

We are all participants in agriculture, shaping the world every time we eat. Whether we are making choices for food security, taste and nutrition, or shifting our environmental impact, eating in accordance with the seasonal harvest is a true, just, and beautiful way to feed ourselves. When we eat from a diverse ecosystem, we grow one in turn.

* We do not ship. Our delivery locations are chosen to support our vision of overlapping regional food systems. While we feed those who most closely share our fields, forests, and river ecosystems, we make an annual trip to Ojai, CA to Aimee’s hometown.

In making the decision to purchase meat from Square Mile Ranch, you have engaged in a commitment to the well-being of a vital, rich, and complex system. It’s a commitment to embracing more of what feeds an animal that lives its life on pasture. Delicious, healthy, and natural, it’s a commitment to land, air and water. To family. To community. 

This is a commitment to the whole of eating; a conscious choice of self-reliance and nourishment. Yes, it is a decision that requires an investment in more of the whole of the animal. Relearning to stock our freezers two to three times a year reminds us of the inherent seasonality of the harvest.

We can assure that you’ll find it a decision wholly satisfying.
